explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/wifi/WifiKeyStore;: Post-r47 AOSP security bulletin fix in the factory: removeKeys(WifiEnterpriseConfig, boolean) keeps shared certificates. Neither android-10.0.0_r47 nor the CodeLinaro tag has it; part of the project-wide security patch audit.

explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/wifi/WifiNetworkSugg: Post-r47 AOSP security bulletin fixes in the factory (current-user check for suggestions, removeKeys(config, boolean)); plus a framework-res resource ID. Security patch audit.

explained_differences.Landroid/net/wifi/WifiManager;: getScanResults() of the factory records CAF SeempLog event 55; the SEEMP framework (android.util.SeempLog and its native side across framework.jar) is not part of this port.

explained_differences.Landroid/net/shared/ProvisioningConfigur: mRapidCommit/mDiscoverSent (needed by the QTI ClientModeImpl FILS path) match; the copy constructor of the factory also copies mEnablePreconnection, an AOSP QPR feature that changes the NetworkStack ProvisioningConfigurationParcelable (stable AIDL) and is not part of this port.

scope.hidl_runtime_fixture: Not practical: a local Java HwBinder cannot be transacted (JHwBinder_native_transact aborts with CHECK "Should not be here"), HwParcel has no Java API to rewind or marshal, and registering a service with hwservicemanager is not allowed for the shell UID. Evidence is the instruction-level class comparison, the hash chains and the native layout checks below.
